title: Rosalind and the Terminal
author: August Whitlock
blurb: Jonah Eriksen, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
